title: What If The Chemistry Teacher Said Yes?
description:
A broke chemistry teacher gets cancer... then the call of a lifetime. This time, he says YES. Everyone's life gets better. Well, almost everyone's.
Whose glow-up was the funniest? Tell me below.
lines: On his fiftieth birthday, chemistry teacher Wendell Gray coughed so hard at the car wash, a customer tipped him out of pity.
The doctor said: lung cancer. His insurance said: "Have you tried... not having cancer?"
Then his rich old friends, the Brainleys, called. They'd pay for everything, and give him a job at BrainCorp.
Every cell of Wendell's ego screamed no. The cancer cells screamed louder. He said yes.
On day one, they introduced him as the guy who sold his half of a billion-dollar company for five grand. Polite applause.
Wendell beat the cancer. His hair grew back, which honestly devastated him.
His old student Jordy Blue became a tattoo artist. Every customer wanted the same thing: "Dude, chemistry!" across their butt.
His brother-in-law Rick, a cop with nobody to chase, gave forty-five minute speeches about his rocks. "They're minerals, Mona!"
Mona stole one of them. Then all of them.
His wife Shelly finally had the boring, honest husband she wanted. Six months later she was flirting with her boss Ted, purely out of boredom.
Junior ate breakfast every morning in peace, and gained forty pounds.
Mister Fredo sold only chicken. Very, very clean chicken. He has still never smiled.
Old Moe retired to the park and lectured the pigeons about half measures.
Toro opened a burrito truck. "Hot! Hot! Hot!" Health inspectors refuse to go near it.
Timmy the exterminator stayed so polite, the cockroaches left out of fear.
Wendell was healthy, rich, respected... and so bored, he taught chemistry to the neighbour's cat.
Only one man's life got worse: lawyer Sal Bestman, now defending a man who assaulted a vending machine.
At three a.m., Wendell's phone rang.
*"Wendell! Sal! One business idea. You, me, an RV in the desert. Completely legal... mostly."
Wendell looked at his perfect, boring life. Then at the bald head he'd been secretly shaving.
*"Sal... I'm in." "Great! Bring snacks."
cta: Tag a friend who would say yes
